messages:
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@spartatech.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-19T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Initial invoice intake question for SpartaTech activation

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Two quick follow-ups from our finance team about the invoice submission path so we can finalize the activation checklist:

1) Do you require invoices to come through the portal (preferred) or is emailing invoices to invoices@redwood.com still supported as a fallback?
2) For our multi-location billing, can we send a single envelope with several invoices attached, or does each invoice need to be a distinct email/CSV row?
3) How do you want PO references stamped? We sometimes include multiple PO numbers on a single invoice (one per line item).

I've attached a CSV with a couple of sample rows from our system to show how we currently emit line items. Could you confirm which fields you need to map on your end so we can export properly?

Attachments: spartatech_invoice_samples.csv (CSV, 5 rows)

Appreciate the help — cc'ing our onboarding mailbox in case they need to add context.

Best,
Lucia
Finance Operations | SpartaTech
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@spartatech.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, Onboarding <onboarding@spartatech.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T10:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial invoice intake question for SpartaTech activation

Hi Lucia,

Thanks — this is helpful. Short answers first, then a couple of requests: 

- Portal-first policy: We prefer the portal for production invoices (automated acknowledgements, idempotency, metadata capture). Email is supported as a documented fallback during go-live and for vendors that cannot use the portal.
- Envelope vs single-email rows: We accept a single email with multiple attached PDFs (envelope) during the migration period, but each invoice should still be represented as either (a) one PDF per invoice attachment AND/OR (b) a single CSV with one row per invoice line (preferred for high-volume suppliers).
- PO stamping: For PO-driven customers we require a PO reference at the invoice header level and strongly prefer one PO per invoice. If you need to include multiple POs, include a PO column on each line so we can reliably map lineitems to PO numbers.

Requests: 
1) Can you add a column called po_number and a column called ship_to_entity in the sample export (we saw multi-location rows, but need a canonical field).
2) Please confirm whether your accounting system emits tax_at_line (tax per line) or tax_total (one tax amount at invoice level).
3) If you plan to use envelope uploads, please send one concrete sample PDF or a zip of 2–3 PDFs so we can validate OCR/extraction.

I've attached our lightweight PO-mapping guide to show the minimal fields we consume (po id, line_num, amount, currency, tax_total, invoice_date, supplier_invoice_id). During the pilot we can accept email attachments, but we will move to portal-only within 60 days of go-live.

Next steps: If you can send an updated CSV and one PDF sample by end of day tomorrow we will run a quick mapping test and confirm any additional transforms.

Thanks — copying Vanessa and Irene who will own the activation test and mapping updates.

--
Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-11-20T16:24:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Initial invoice intake question for SpartaTech activation — action items

Vanessa / Irene — quick internal note, forwarding the vendor confirmation. Key asks for our runbook: 

1) Validate the sample CSV (spartatech_invoice_samples_v2.csv) against our PO-mapping-guide.pdf fields. If any fields are missing, create a small delta transform and note in the onboarding doc.
2) Run one mapping test with sample_invoice_001.pdf (they said PDFs are ERP-native, so minimal OCR risk) — confirm that supplier_invoice_id maps to external_supplier_invoice_id.
3) Confirm whether we can accept envelope zip uploads during pilot (I said yes for migration, but we should standardize a naming convention). Proposal: subject token "SPARTATECH-<supplier_invoice_id>" in email subject if envelope used, and portal upload idempotency tokens once portal is adopted.

I'll draft a short template response to send to SpartaTech summarizing these points and the 60-day portal-first timeline. Please reply by EOD tomorrow with any blockers.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Vendor Operations
